byo-subscription.rationale: Pro/Max setup-token authentication is explicitly documented.

own-server.rationale: Own GitHub runner executes the action; no self-hosted web control plane is implied.

local.rationale: The action is a composite GitHub Action that runs only as a workflow step on a GitHub runner; no local entrypoint exists, and a self-hosted runner maps to own-server.

vendor-cloud.rationale: The action provisions no ADE-vendor compute; runners are chosen by the user, and the only Anthropic-hosted piece is the app-token exchange, not agent execution.

unattended-triggers.rationale: GitHub event and scheduled workflows invoke explicit prompts.

laptop-independent.rationale: Remote runner workflow proceeds after browser disconnect; a runner on the laptop would still need that host online.

pr-workflow.rationale: Default mode prepares branch/commits and a human PR link; it also updates an existing PR branch.

self-hosting.rationale: The existing finding explicitly establishes that the core action runs on the user's runner; GitHub and model providers remain dependencies.

free-plan.rationale: The complete action distribution is free under MIT with no paid action tier. Claude subscriptions/API charges and GitHub runner charges are separate.

free-tier.rationale: MIT-licensed action used free of charge from its public repository; no paid plan. Model and runner costs excluded. Scope: Claude Code GitHub Action.

starting-price.rationale: No paid plan for the action in the repository; it is free to use. Model and runner costs excluded. Scope: Claude Code GitHub Action.

mobile-web.rationale: No mobile or responsive product interface exists in the repository; GitHub mobile web is a different product.

cli.rationale: The pinned distribution is a composite GitHub Action, with no native client or separately distributed product-owned CLI. Runner operating systems and GitHub clients are distinct.

parallel-runs.rationale: Independent workflow jobs execute separate action instances and job-scoped Claude runs; GitHub supplies quotas and any configured workflow serialization.

issue-tracking.rationale: Bounded inspection of src, base-action and workflow input handling establishes external GitHub issue context and no native issue/task store.

multiplayer.rationale: Distinct GitHub users with write access can @claude on the same PR. Each instruction starts a new job reading shared PR history and using its branch; no live input to an already-running job is claimed.

coordinator.rationale: The pinned wrapper supplies one Claude execution and GitHub tools, with no product-owned coordinator role or managed delegate-session tools.

web-client.rationale: Bounded scan of the repository at v1.0.276 finds no web application; users interact only through GitHub pages. docs/create-app.html is a GitHub App manifest helper, not a work interface.

worktree.rationale: Bounded scan finds no git worktree isolation; the run uses the single checkout with a dedicated branch.

container.rationale: No container option is configured by the action; the optional bubblewrap PID namespace is recorded under os_sandbox as partial and the docs state it is not a sandbox.

vm.rationale: The action provisions no VM; runner VM isolation belongs to the runner provider and is not an option the action documents.

roles.rationale: The only access model is the GitHub repository permission check; no named roles exist in the action.

sso.rationale: Bounded scan for sso, saml, okta and scim finds nothing in the pinned release; workload identity federation is for model access, not user SSO.

review-ui.rationale: The action ships no diff or review interface; it posts inline comments that GitHub displays.

telemetry-opt-out.rationale: No documented control disables telemetry: the action only forwards the Claude CLI telemetry variables and passes an input-presence map to the CLI; no input or doc offers an opt-out.

paid-from.rationale: MIT-licensed action with no paid tier in the license, README, docs or action manifest at v1.0.276; model and runner charges are separate.
